label: 7360 ISAM FX-4 OLT
description: Nokia 7360 ISAM FX-4 access node/OLT: 5RU shelf with 4 line-termination (LT) slots and 2 NT controller slots on a 2x 100G/slot backplane, 64 GPON ports at 16 ports/slot and ready for XGS-PON/TWDM-PON line cards. This spec models one 16-port GPON LT card in slot 1 (1/1/1-16) plus the four configurable 10G/1G SFP+ network links on the FANT-F controller (1/9/1-4).
